name: gitaur
description: A local Git client with a graph workspace and dedicated commit window.

scripts.pack: node scripts/native.cjs tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/collect-release.cjs
scripts.pack:installer: node scripts/native.cjs tauri build --bundles nsis && node scripts/collect-release.cjs --bundles
scripts.pack:linux: node scripts/native.cjs tauri build --bundles deb,appimage && node scripts/collect-release.cjs --bundles
scripts.test: npm run test:renderer && npm run test:native
scripts.test:e2e: node test/tauri-smoke.cjs && node test/form-validation-ui.cjs && node test/repository-browsing.cjs && node test/git-workflows-ui.cjs && node test/conflict-resolver-ui.cjs && node test/merge-drafts-ui.cjs && node test/structural-conflicts-ui.cjs && node test/repository-tools-ui.cjs && node test/daily-workflows-ui.cjs && node test/history-workflows-ui.cjs && node test/reference-actions-ui.cjs && node test/commit-window-ui.cjs && node test/window-state-ui.cjs && node test/activity-ui.cjs && node test/diff-copy-ui.cjs && node test/update-notification-ui.cjs
scripts.check:native: node scripts/native.cjs cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts test *.json *.ts *.html src-tauri/*.json src-tauri/capabilities/*.json && node scripts/native.cjs cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts test *.json *.ts *.html src-tauri/*.json src-tauri/capabilities/*.json && node scripts/native.cjs cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check
